glosses: marco, Spanish mark (a traditional unit of weight, equivalent to about 230 g)
mark (other similar half-pound weights in other measurement systems)

examples.text: ¿Te gusta el marco de esta pintura?
examples.en: Do you like the frame on this painting?

examples.text: El marco del edificio está ahora completo.
examples.en: The frame of the building is now complete.
